public_rationale: The greater-than-1-GW component is supported as a report about abandoned proposed agreements. The stronger inference is not settled. Contemporary sources describe power constraints and changes in who would supply OpenAI, while OpenAI's announcement retains Microsoft in its infrastructure plans. Those facts weaken the claim of incompatibility, but do not conclusively establish Microsoft's reasons. Scoring only the capacity figure would omit a material part of the sentence.
limitations: The quantitative evidence ultimately relies on TD Cowen's channel checks.
A proposed project withdrawal is not necessarily an equivalent net reduction in expansion.
A company's stated growth plans do not independently establish its private expectations.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Microsoft is effectively cutting its data center expansion by over a gigawatt of capacity, if not more, and these cuts are impossible to reconcile with the expectation that generative AI will be a massive, transformative technological phenomenon.

statement.excerpt: The reason I'm writing in such blunt-force terms is that I want to make it clear that Microsoft is effectively cutting its data center expansion by over a gigawatt of capacity, if not more, and it’s impossible to reconcile these cuts with the expectation that generative AI will be a massive, transformative technological phenomenon.

from_speaker: effectively cutting its data center expansion
generative AI will be a massive, transformative technological phenomenon
our_interpretation: The claim contains a measurable observation and a broader inference; both must be retained.
The capacity observation includes abandoned proposed agreements, consistent with the surrounding discussion.
The ordinary reading of the inference is that these withdrawals cannot reasonably coexist with expectations of major generative-AI growth.
The February reporting through March 3 anchors the observed cuts. The speaker supplies no numerical definition or deadline for transformative growth.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes more than 1 GW of abandoned prospective capacity and establishes that these decisions are incompatible with a reasonable expectation of major generative-AI growth.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish no more than 1 GW was abandoned, or evidence establishes a concrete explanation under which the withdrawals coexist with continued expectations of major generative-AI growth.
